facts.fact: MFWA says a policy in force since 2021 requires state agencies to transfer the data they hold to the national Diamniadio data centre.
MFWA says state agencies have been moving their data to the Diamniadio national storage centre since November 2023, the health ministry reportedly over 80% of its data by January 2024.
